decisions.reason: The ID Vault was launched only in 2023 as a feature of the super-app platform, so its value is still uncertain and carrying it costs little, which makes the option worth keeping.
The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the payment framework, so it might be folded in, but it is cheap to keep while its value is still unresolved.
The NFC tag authenticator is a niche hardware-linked option with little visibility, but it is too early to conclude it has failed and keeping it costs little.
The payment and wallet framework has its own page and is core to the firm's payment capability, so the option still has value.
The super-app platform is the firm's flagship and strategic direction, so it is the main option to invest in further.
The application shielding library builds on the firm's decades of security expertise and has its own page, so it is low-cost and established.
